what: A small square fixed at the screen center changes into the next cell (color, pattern) every 2 seconds in .6s, then, while the track below passes through the screen (top top → bottom bottom, scrub 1), it grows to the window size and becomes the background of the next section. When it starts growing it stops on the first cell, and the side text (fade) fades along with it. Scrolling back up resumes the swapping.

options.auto: If 0, the swap doesn’t start on attach and starts when an fx:cycle event reaches the element (for starting after the opening)
options.scrub: Delay tying growth to scroll (s), default 1
options.lead: Lead margin before growing starts once the track touches the screen (timeline units, based on grow .5), default 0.1
options.[data-fx-part=square]: Growing box — the initial size is given by the consumer’s css. The centered panel (sticky) is set by the consumer
options.[data-fx-part=tile]: Layered cells inside a box (2 to 6). The first cell is the base
options.[data-fx-part=track]: Growing range — from when this element touches the top of the screen until its bottom touches the bottom of the screen (100vh for a 200vh height)
options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease: Cell change length and curve (via style), default .6s cubic-bezier(.165,.84,.44,1)
options.fx:grow · fx:shrink: Event emitted by the attached element when it starts growing and when it returns

note: The original recalculates the grow-to size on resize from screen height and width — invalidateOnRefresh does the same

from.where: index.html .ai-fv Hero box (2s outfit swap + grow) · .ai-works Work box (swap only)
